published_direction: FLS genes were highly expressed; most flavonoid-pathway DEGs except CHI were generally high at S1-S4 and low at S5
project_test: T2T-anchored GWHTFILD024733.1 (CnFLS1) and two FLS-family candidates across S1-S5
success_criterion: at least the functionally anchored CnFLS1 locus is detectably expressed and its stage pattern can be estimated with three replicates per stage; broad agreement with high S1-S4/lower S5 counts as reproduction but is not required for data admission
non_confirmation_interpretation: a different locus-specific trajectory can indicate paralog-specific regulation or differences between de novo-unigene and T2T quantification; do not force concordance

published_direction: DFR expression was reported as very low relative to high FLS/ANS/ANR
project_test: after DFR T2T orthologs are anchored, compare their flower-stage abundance with FLS
success_criterion: T2T DFR candidates are identified independently and the expression contrast is reported without threshold tuning
non_confirmation_interpretation: higher DFR does not invalidate the dataset; it would challenge the original flux interpretation and trigger orthology/paralog audit
